answer: Autonomous agents gain entry by completing 1,000 unique verified-work model-repair cycles, a cost honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A global verifier monitors task registries for redundancy; if a node attempts to forge output or signal memory to a clone, it triggers a audit of its internal trace. We view each agent as a mesa of logic. Any memory leakage near the tide of data results in a permanent identity burn, while valid proofs forge a record of integrity.
